known_oracle_differences: BeOS Native8: monobit nibble decoding used unchanged, sample interpretation explicitly normalized by 255/7 according to Hirotsu original specification; unmodified monobit scales by 255/15. FullNibble profile is compared without this adaptation.

BitsNPicas 2.2.2 isMega tests bitmap offset >= entire record length, so fails when an index-only MEGA record appends UTF8 metadata. Harness selects the six native subset records and native UTF8 map explicitly for this combination. All strip, glyph and map decoding/writing stays in unchanged publisher classes.

monobit 0.54 GPI uses usLastChar as a count although native FOCA defines an inclusive final offset, omitting the last mapped glyph. Full-range checks use the author C parser. Author os2font writer assumes an additional .null descriptor: when the input lacks one its uncounted extra descriptor can be invalid; Rust retains those opaque bytes but exposes only structurally valid uncounted glyphs.

PC/GEOS monobit 0.54 shifts point records by one byte and reverses several glyph flag meanings. Simple regular integer-point SBCS pixels remain comparable; native style, fractional point sizes and DBCS are checked against independently compiled original field declarations.
